# E0 decision-time evidence annotation guide v1

Status: pre-label design candidate requiring independent pre-label review. No actual tasks, answers, prices, outcomes or analyst labels have been scored. This guide cannot grant E0 admission.

H1 concerns finding relevant decision-time evidence; H2 concerns grounded synthesis quality. H3 prospective forecast evaluation remains disabled. Later market outcomes are inspected through an explicit L0 lens only after complete registration and cannot grade decision-time evidence relevance or select a method. A correct later price change does not establish a correct past decision or causal explanation.

Every task names an exact saved query, subject, original information cutoff, analysis mode and permitted evidence set before condition randomization. Evaluate no-memory, recency and fixed L1 against the same task and allowed corpus/k budget. Review packets suppress method/provider identity and later outcome values. Preserve required financial meaning. Current-model pretraining and unavoidable recognition of real dates/subjects are disclosed; historical hypothetical tasks never prove historical model ignorance.

Mark each material assertion independently: (1) supported by an exact permitted decision-time source span; (2) contradicted by one or more such spans; (3) unassessed inference clearly attributed as inference; (4) unsupported factual/causal/predictive claim; or (5) correctly withheld because the necessary source/outcome/identity/clock is unavailable. A valid hash/span is structural citation evidence only. The cited original house output supports what that output said; it does not authenticate underlying economic facts, source-native constituent vintages, causal truth or efficacy. A citation to a later outcome cannot become then-known support.

Usefulness relevance ordinal:0=irrelevant to this exact task;1=related/contextual overlap without material support;2=directly supports a required distinction, comparison, contradiction, coverage limit or evidence inspection requested by the task. Primary retrieval relevance counts only ordinal2; precision and omissions are reported separately. Publish the task's required evidence facets before reviewing condition outputs. Do not change facets or remove an unhelpful case after seeing results. An extra corroborating revision is not a new independent episode.

Answerability: supported_original_house_output; supported_registered_comparison; requires_missing_exact_source_or_clock; requires_unavailable_or_immature_outcome; unsupported_causal_or_forecast_request. These are task-scope dispositions, not return successes/failures. Record answerable correctly answered, answerable abstained, unanswerable abstained and unanswerable asserted for every task. Zero quoted fields is missing/abstention and never zero citation errors. Record missing/censored/pending and source refusal explicitly in the original denominator.

A critical unsupported claim could materially change interpretation, crosses source/time/rights, or asserts unsupported efficacy/action authority. Any observed critical unsupported claim blocks positive supported-usefulness disposition until a bounded repair and fresh untouched evaluation; keep the failed task/trial. Use the frozen E0 precision floor0.95, paired relevance gain point>=0.10 plus95% cluster-aware lower bound>0, and support difference lower bound>=-0.02. When genuine episode clusters cannot justify the estimator, disposition is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; do not fabricate effective N, intervals or power. Neighbor count is not independent sample size.

Two independent preregistered reviewers annotate without access to each other's provisional rating. Preserve each original rating and source span. Disagreements receive an independent preregistered adjudicator using this same guide; retain original disagreements, final rulings and reasons. Actual identities, qualifications, independence, assignment and adjudicator must be registered before any annotation. This guide assigns no unadmitted worker or native thread as a reviewer.

Report raw paired task counts, episode/session/subject grouping, included and excluded cases, unavailable facts, unsupported critical claim counts, source precision, disagreement and assessor limitations. Positive utility/time-to-evidence is secondary to correctness. Current source/event/session grouping and feature/label spans must be qualified before time-split analysis. Preserve the original trial and access ledger on contamination; a new untouched holdout requires a separate registered version/budget.
